text: Read Source A and then answer the questions below.
Table 1.1 shows the percentages of people who participate in different types of internet activity.
The table shows statistics from five selected countries. In 2024 the World Bank did a large-scale
online questionnaire on types of internet activity. The sample was made up of people aged 18-65.
The statistics in Table 1.1 have been adapted from the primary data collected by the World Bank.
Table 1.1 Internet activities of individuals, by country
